Make Christmas Eve a little more magical in ten minutes. 🎄✨

Your child's name goes on Santa's Nice List – officially, with a gold star, a letter from Santa and reindeer food for the lawn.

✨ WHAT'S INSIDE (10 pages)
• Official Santa's Nice List certificate in 2 styles (red & gold, green)
• A Letter from Santa with blanks to write your child's name and a kind thing they did
• "Good things I did this year" checklist to fill in together
• 6 reindeer food tags + magic reindeer food recipe (no glitter – safe for birds)
• 3 special delivery envelope labels from the North Pole
• Santa's Elf Report kindness award

Write the names by hand with a gold or red pen – it looks lovely on card stock.

👧👦 For kids ages 2 to 10. Perfect for Christmas Eve boxes.

HOW IT WORKS
INSTANT DIGITAL DOWNLOAD. No physical item will be shipped. US Letter + A4 PDF included.

PLEASE NOTE
For personal use only. Please do not resell or share the files.

Designed by our small shop, AureliaVenn, with the help of AI tools.
